chars.AMINE: a slim young Moroccan man about twenty with short black curly hair and a light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light-blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.KHALTI: an elegant Moroccan woman about forty-two with warm brown eyes and a confident smile, wearing a beige silk headscarf loosely tied, a long burgundy open cardigan over a black top and black wide trousers, large gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from inside a modest Moroccan family living room, looking toward the doorway where KHALTI stands mid-gesture, holding up a straw beach bag and a sun hat, leaning in with a playful inviting smile and raised eyebrows as if asking a question, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, afternoon light. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AMINE sits on a colourful Moroccan sedari sofa in a modest living room, holding his phone, looking up surprised with wide eyes and a half smile, pointing at himself as if saying 'me?'. Head-to-waist framing. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AMINE and KHALTI walk side by side on a sunny Moroccan beach with turquoise sea and a few parasols, KHALTI laughing and pointing at the waves, AMINE carrying her beach bag and looking a bit awkward. Wide shot, both faces visible. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On a seaside corniche in a small northern Moroccan town at golden hour, KHALTI shows AMINE around, pointing toward white houses on a hill while he follows her gaze curiously. Both faces visible, medium shot. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Moroccan medina street with shops and lanterns, a couple of men in the background stare at KHALTI, and AMINE walks close beside her with a protective serious look, glancing back at them. Faces visible. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AMINE and KHALTI sit at a small table of a Moroccan seaside cafe with mint tea glasses, KHALTI laughing warmly, AMINE smiling shyly and looking away, his phone face-down on the table. Medium shot, faces visible. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AMINE stands in his small bedroom answering a phone call, phone at his ear, surprised grin, eyebrows raised, jacket half on as if getting ready to go out. Head-to-waist framing. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At a small Moroccan grill restaurant with skewers smoking on the grill, AMINE hands coins and a banknote to the cook while KHALTI sits at a plastic table behind him smiling and waving at him. Faces visible. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment entrance, KHALTI stands with a small rolling suitcase beside her, smiling mischievously at AMINE, while AMINE stands frozen in shock with his mouth open and eyes wide. Medium shot, both faces clearly visible. 2D animated cartoon style.
